Shadrack Sibiya, who was already suspended from his role as deputy national police commissioner over allegations he interfered with political killings investigations, was arrested on Monday.
He is facing charges of rape, people trafficking, promoting the sexual grooming of a child and two counts of grooming a child.

Both sides are now accusing the other of triggering a return to open conflict.
